say:1:1121138001:1.text: I just remembered the goal I'd been pursuing before.
say:1:1121138001:1.source_cn: 之前一直在追逐的目标，我想起来了。
say:1:1121138001:1.male: I just remembered the goal I'd been pursuing before.
say:1:1121138001:1.female: I just remembered the goal I'd been pursuing before.

choice_prompt:2:1121138001.text: I just remembered the goal I'd been pursuing before.
choice_prompt:2:1121138001.source_cn: 之前一直在追逐的目标，我想起来了。
choice_prompt:2:1121138001.male: I just remembered the goal I'd been pursuing before.
choice_prompt:2:1121138001.female: I just remembered the goal I'd been pursuing before.

say:3:1121138003:1.text: My memory is like sparks flickering all over the place, but there's one thing I should never have forgotten: <style="highlight">I was pursuing a Hypogean</style>.
say:3:1121138003:1.source_cn: 记忆就像是飞溅的火花一样，零碎地闪烁着。但是这件事，我...

say:4:1121138004:1.text: A Hypogean! Did you battle with it? Is that why you lost your memory?
say:4:1121138004:1.source_cn: 恶魔！你和那个恶魔战斗了吗？所以才会失去记忆？

say:5:1121138005:1.text: ... I have no clue, as the rest of my memory hasn't resurfaced yet. The appearance and the identity of that Hypogean is still obscured in darkness.
say:5:1121138005:1.source_cn: ……我不知道，除了这件事，其他的记忆还没有重燃。那个恶...

say:6:1121138006:2.text: However, this place feels familiar to me.
say:6:1121138006:2.source_cn: 但是，我觉得眼前这一切都很熟悉。

say:7:1121138007:1.text: That's all I can remember. Does the info help?
say:7:1121138007:1.source_cn: 我只能想起这些，不知道对你们有没有帮助？

choice_prompt:8:1121138007.text: That's all I can remember. Does the info help?
choice_prompt:8:1121138007.source_cn: 我只能想起这些，不知道对你们有没有帮助？

say:9:1121138008:1.text: Phew, I just sent a letter to Holistone with a carrier pigeon. A troop of soldiers will be here soon to carry the statue. I can finally wrap this up and report back to General Hogan.
say:9:1121138008:1.source_cn: 呼，我刚刚用信鸽给圣石镇送了信，很快会有一队士兵来日神...

say:10:1121138009:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't forget to check out the statue when it's back.
say:10:1121138009:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't forget to check out the statue when it's back.
say:10:1121138009:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't forget to check out the statue when it's back.

narration:11:1121138010:0.text: Sometime later, Dura's Statue is carried back to Holistone.
narration:11:1121138010:0.source_cn: 一段时间后，女神像被运回了圣石镇

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 我失去了一个失忆的病友……

choice:8:2:3.text: I wish my memories came back too...
choice:8:2:3.male: I wish my memories came back too...
choice:8:2:3.female: I wish my memories came back too...

say:13:1121138002:1.text: Your magic did draw me to you, but I was actually tracking down someone else before sensing your magic...
say:13:1121138002:1.source_cn: 你的魔力确实令人亲近，但在感受到你的魔力之前，我在追踪...
say:13:1121138002:1.male: Your magic did draw me to you, but I was actually tracking down someone else before sensing your magic...
say:13:1121138002:1.female: Your magic did draw me to you, but I was actually tracking down someone else before sensing your magic...

choice:2:1:2.text: Weren't you looking for me earlier?
